angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 715,875 km at 313.65 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.1883 +/- 0.0150 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 313.65 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.029 +/- 0.056 solar radii from Gillon et al. 2009, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract): 715,875 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.96 +/- 0.13 solar masses from Gillon et al. 2009, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5700 +/- 100 K from Gillon et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gillon et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-5.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.396, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): spectral type G5, from Triaud et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...524A..25T/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-5: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Gillon et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.06717, from Baluev et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.450.3101B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): age 5.4 Gyr, from Gillon et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): rotation period 16.2 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-5 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.5 km/s, from Gillon et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..259G/abstract)
